captions: You almost stayed in. Again. Fifth night this week.
Outside: fresh footprints. Small steps. A walking stick.
Someone old already went. In this cold.
You follow them. Your breath turns to clouds.
The green minaret. The footprints stop at its door.
Inside: warm carpet. Old Yusuf, snow still on his shoulders.
He's 81. He nods at the space beside him.
It was never too hard. It was six minutes.

post.caption:
-4°C. 6 minutes to the mosque. “Too cold” for Allah? ❄️

Someone older than you already walked there tonight. The cold was never the real reason.

“Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.” (2:286)

Today at Maghrib: put your coat on. Walk the 6 minutes.
